nodes.name: Relevance Baseline Results
nodes.summary: Regression baseline results for UI/UX relevance retrieval testing. Contains 94 test case results with actual retrieved items, diagnostic metadata (margin, top_score, token_coverage), per-case grades and scores (MRR@3, NDCG@3, P@1, P@3), and aggregate metrics split by calibration (44 cases) and held_out (44 cases). Used as the reference baseline for detecting regressions in the relevance engine.

nodes.name: Relevance Test Cases
nodes.summary: Test case definitions for evaluating the ui-ux-pro-max relevance engine. Defines schema version, grade semantics (2=direct, 1=useful, 0=not relevant), global negative applicability (hard-negatives across 12 domains and 23 stacks), and 94 cases spanning domain queries (style, color, chart, landing, product, ux, typography, icons, gsap, react, web, google-fonts), stack-specific queries (23 frameworks), auto-routing tests, hard-negatives (gibberish, out-of-scope), and design-system coherence cases.

nodes.name: Relevance Quality Gates
nodes.summary: Quality gate configuration for the relevance retrieval system. Defines provisional baseline regression gates with metric floors for routingAccuracy (≥0.875), precisionAt1 (≥0.763), precisionAt3 (≥0.382), mrrAt3 (≥0.836), ndcgAt3 (≥0.837), negativeAbstention (≥0.912), typoRecoveryAt3 (≥1.0), and designSystemCoherence (≥0.719). Includes split-specific thresholds for calibration and held_out subsets, sample minimums per category, 16 locked regression cases, and proposed final quality targets.
